title: VEA, TCHF: Big ETF Inflows
text:
VEA, TCHF: Big ETF Inflows Wednesday, January 3, 10:50 AM ET 10 Worst Performing ETFs » Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF (AMEX: VEA ), which added 7,001,849 units, or a 0.5% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of VEA, in morning trading today Nestle ( NSRGY ) is down about 0.7%, and Novartis (NYSE: NVS ) is up by about 0.5%. 
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the iShares Edge MSCI Multifactor Technology ETF (AMEX: TCHF ), which added 50,000 units, for a 33.3% increase in outstanding units. Among the largest underlying components of TCHF, in morning trading today Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is up about 1%, and Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT ) is up by about 0.5%. 
For MarketNewsVideo.com, I'm Sayoko Murase.
